process_behavior.meaning: Transports shipments from the Cascade regional blood centre to St. Vincent regional hospital. A shipment takes about 3 hours to reach the hospital and be received into its bank.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: Operates on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with shipments departing at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles and arriving approximately 3 hours later, at 7:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: Not applicable; the courier service does not have a rate, it simply transports shipments that occur on a fixed schedule.
